title: Read experimental build file-access records correctly
goal: Observe real build file IO through a composed experimental Windows x64 Visual Studio MSBuild observer; preserve contexts, errors and cancellation without publishing partial cache state.

No production resources, remote storage, process arguments or recurring native matrix.
